data.title: Starry Night Building
data.description: Practice making sets of stars to help light up the night sky!

challenges.instruction: Put three stars in the night sky.
challenges.hint: Try tapping on the empty sky to place your stars one by one.
challenges.narration: Let us make a special group of stars in the night sky.

challenges.instruction: Put five stars in the night sky.
challenges.hint: Keep tapping to add more stars until you have enough.
challenges.narration: Wonderful! Now let us build a bigger set of stars.

challenges.instruction: Put eight stars in the night sky.
challenges.hint: Count each star as you place it to make sure you have the right amount.
challenges.narration: You are doing great! Let us try building a new set.

challenges.instruction: Put ten stars in the night sky.
challenges.hint: Take your time and count carefully as you build your final set.
challenges.narration: This is our last challenge. Let us build our biggest set of stars yet!

report.instruction: Put three stars in the night sky.
report.watcherShown: 👀 Yellow stars are glowing bright yellow near the moon!
